messages:
alex: Quick async — I'm assembling a dependency matrix for the GPU ramp and need explicit owners + short ETAs. I dropped a stub sheet: https://go/redwood/gpu-ramp-matrix (please edit). Current lines I have:
```
1) Procurement (purchase + shipment)   -> owner: ?   -> RES ID: ?
2) Rack/power validation             -> owner: ?   -> need headroom #s
3) Network / cabling                  -> owner: ?   -> cable kit ETA
4) Runtime kernel + NCCL perf patches -> owner: ?   -> PRs/branch
5) Dedicated reservation + quotas    -> owner: ?   -> reservation window
6) Canary / QA schedule               -> owner: ?   -> smoke tests + metrics
7) Docs / runbooks                    -> owner: ?   -> playbook PRs
```
If you own a row, reply with your name + short ETA (even if fuzzy). I plan to lock the schedule by EOD Fri and propose a first canary window the week after. @maria @jonathan @sara @kevin :flag-us: :eyes:

maria: I'll take procurement. Vendor (GigaNodes) confirmed a tentative BOL week of Apr 20–24, but customs + chassis hold could slip us 1–2 weeks. I filed reservation RES-7892 in the procurement portal. Adding note to the sheet now. Will confirm final ASN as soon as logistics ack. :shipping:

jonathan: Runtime owner here. We're blocked on a small kernel NVLINK / NCCL regression — PR #4123 is open and has a green perf bench locally but needs one more review and the CI hang fix. ETA to merge if review lands = ~72h. After merge we need to push a runtime image tag and pin for dedicated. I'll add the PR and a branch link to the sheet. Also want to flag: model-serve image needs a 1.2.1 tag for quantization kernels.

sara: SRE on power/network checks. Rack-level power validation done for 6 racks but I still need the final rack allocation list (which seats get the H100s). If anyone has the final placement, drop it in the sheet. We have ~12% headroom across the current allocation; if we add 12 more GPUs we'll be at ~2–3% headroom — need to confirm PDUs and breaker capacity. I'll schedule a quick power review call tomorrow if needed. cc @kevin for runbook hooks. :battery:

kevin: I'll own docs/runbooks. I'll prepare a short support playbook (how to escalate, key metrics to watch: 99p latency, error-rate by model, KV cache hit %) and a deployment checklist. Please ping when PRs (runtime + reservation) land. Small ask: can procurement add expected ASN and rack assignment to the sheet so I can include exact hardware IDs in the runbook. :memo:

alex: Great — thanks. Action items I'm capturing now:
- @maria add ASN + shipping ETA to RES-7892 (sheet)
- @jonathan finish PR #4123 + post runtime image tag
- @sara drop final rack list + power headroom numbers
- @kevin draft support & onboarding runbook PR
- owners add ETA column in sheet (even fuzzy)
I'll tentatively schedule canary window starting Wed Apr 26 for 48h, canary traffic small (10 qps) and smoke jobs: startup, one-shot perf, end-to-end inference. If any owner expects >1 week slip, call it out here so we can push the window.

ops-bot: Reservation RES-7892 created in procurement system at 2287654400. Status: pending-fulfillment.

maria: Added ASN placeholder (ASN:TBD) and put tentative ship window Apr 20–24 in the sheet. Noting customs risk. If customs hits, new ETA estimate = May 4–10. Also checking cable kit lead time (vendor says 5 business days after BOL).

jonathan: Updated sheet with PR link and noted runtime image tag = redwood/runtime:2026-04-22-kernelfix. Filing a small follow-up PR to pin the tag in the env. Asking @sara for a one-off CI run on the new image once PR merges.

sara: Put a calendar invite for a 15m power check tomorrow 10:30am PT. I'll bring rack list as soon as the procurement team dumps final manifest. If headroom <5% we should plan to stagger activation across two days to avoid breaker trips.

kevin: Starting the runbook draft now. I'll drop a PR link by EOD and include a short escalation matrix. If anyone has sample Grafana panels or alerts you want copied, paste links in the sheet.

alex: Perfect. If anyone wants to reassign ownership, do so now. Otherwise I'll treat the current owners as primary and start prepping the canary playbook. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
